Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C AIIMS RAIPUR . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee.
